## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum, Paseo del Prado, 8. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step into the world of art and culture with a ticket to the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum in Madrid. Located in the vibrant heart of the Spanish capital, this iconic institution is a treasure trove of artistic masterpieces that span centuries and styles, making it a must-visit destination for art enthusiasts and curious minds alike.
>
> Your ticket grants you access to one of the world's most impressive private collections, showcasing over 1,600 works of art carefully curated from various periods and genres. Immerse yourself in the diverse range of artistic movements on display. Marvel at the exquisite Renaissance and Baroque paintings that evoke a sense of grandeur and religious devotion. Admire the intricate brushwork and vibrant colors of the Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterpieces, capturing fleeting moments and emotions. Experience the boldness and experimentation of the avant-garde movements, where artists challenged traditional boundaries and redefined the very concept of art.
>
> Take your time to wander through the galleries, allowing the beauty and power of the art to transport you to different eras and worlds. Allow yourself to be enchanted by the mastery of renowned artists, as their creations transcend time and connect us to the universal language of beauty and human expression.
